name: studywise
description: STUDYWISE. En KI-basert studieassistent for høyere utdanning med integrasjon mot Canvas Instructure. Bachelor i IT 2026.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --raw "pnpm dev:backend" "wait-on tcp:4000 && pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:docs"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter docs build
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter common build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.clean: rimraf backend/dist frontend/.next frontend/.turbo common/dist docs/docs/.vitepress/dist docs/docs/.vitepress/cache .turbo
scripts.clean:all: rimraf backend/dist backend/node_modules frontend/.next frontend/.turbo frontend/node_modules common/dist common/node_modules docs/docs/.vitepress/dist docs/docs/.vitepress/cache docs/node_modules node_modules .turbo pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.clean:install: echo Cleaning all... && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const paths=['backend/node_modules','backend/dist','frontend/node_modules','frontend/.next','common/node_modules','common/dist','docs/node_modules','docs/docs/.vitepress/dist','node_modules','pnpm-lock.yaml'];for(const p of paths){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});}" && echo Installing dependencies... && pnpm install && echo Building project... && pnpm run build
